title: Great tour!
text: Patrick was a great and knowledgable tour guide plus a lot of fun! We learned so much while with him! A great introduction to Barcelona on our first day! Highly recommend!
author: Michaeleen_H

title: Patrick was a great...
text: Patrick was a great guide; he was very knowledgeable of the history of the Gothic Quarter, perfect English, very flexible ... can't go wrong with a private tour as he can cater to your needs. We highly recommend him.
author: Ernest_P

title: Gothic Quarter with Patrick
text: We wanted a tour to kick off our stay in the Gothic Quarter and the Old Town Private Tour with Patrick was perfect.  He met us close to our hotel and we spent the next 4 hours walking thru the Gothic Quarter taking in sights that we would have missed had we not had Patrick's expertise and knowledge.  From ancient roman ruins to the best bakery in town,  Patrick spent time guiding us threw narrow alleyways, boulevards, cathedrals, ruins.  His tour was thorough, fun and made it easy for us to navigate the alleyways in the 4 days we had in Barcelona.  His knowledge was extensive, he was very enga
author: luckycat2

title: History through Stories!
text: A wonderful way to spend an afternoon. Patrick had delightful presentation of the history of Barcelona thru telling great stories.  Highly recommend his tour.
author: Shelly_G

title: Ancient to Modern
text: This tour was all about history and culture.  The history from  the Roman fortress onward. And the culture through modern politics. Very informative.
author: Dixie_W

title: Great walking tour. ...
text: Great walking tour.  English was great- and funny.  So much we didn’t know about Barcelona.  Loved suggestions for lunch-tapas.
author: Cassiey_G

title: A fun learning experience
text: Patrick was muy bien! Very informative and funny. Would highly recommend him.
author: H2237XYmarkh

title: Gothic Quarter Tour
text: Patrick was very informative and entertaining. He gave us an appreciation for the rich history and uniqueness of the Gothic Quarter.
author: Jeff_L

title: Learn Barcelona’s Past
text: Extensive and in-depth tour of Barcelona’s Gothic Quarter. Patrick, our tour guide, provided interesting information about how Barcelona became a major port city. LOTS of walking, but worth it.
author: ElizabethAnnRiggs_B

title: This was a great tour if...
text: This was a great tour if you want to get an up close and personal view of Barcelona’s old city. Patrick Taggart was a great guide as he had institutional knowledge of the Gothic Quarter and surrounding areas. He was personable and very knowledgeable.
author: Rachel_S
